newsitem.title: USA: GTS Duratek to buy Westinghouse unit.
newsitem.headline: GTS Duratek to buy Westinghouse unit.

text.p: GTS Duratek Inc said it has signed a letter of intent to acquire 100 percent of the stock of The Scientific Ecology Group Inc from Westinghouse Electric Corp for $28 million in cash and 156,986 shares of GTS common stock.
The proposed acquisition is subject to the parties entering into a mutually acceptable definitive purchase agreement, certain regulatory approvals and other customary conditions.
GTS Duratek said it expects it will be able to close the transaction by April.
The Scientific Ecology Group, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Westinghouse based in Oak Ridge, Tenn., is a commercial radioactive waste processing company.
It had revenues in 1996 of about $105 million, excluding revenues associated with assets previously sold.

The Scientific Ecology Group recently completed the sale of its interest in a joint venture for the processing of commercial radioactive on exchange resins and certain assets related to that business.
